signal: PrimePay was recognized in Capterra's 2026 Shortlist for Direct Deposit Payroll Software as it grows its unified HCM platform for SMBs

email.body1:
Katie, saw PrimePay landed on Capterra's 2026 Shortlist for payroll software as the unified HCM platform keeps growing.

Growth like that means reps have to ramp on a wider story fast, while more in-market SMB accounts surface than the team can reach. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount and reps spend time selling: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PrimePay off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Katie, quick follow-up for PrimePay.

From an enablement seat, the real cost is rep time: hours lost to research and writing instead of selling, which slows ramp on every new hire and quietly leaves SMB pipeline on the table before anyone sees the gap.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PrimePay needs this quarter, and how taking research and writing off reps speeds it up.
email.body3:
Katie, last bit of proof for PrimePay.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PrimePay's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Katie, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding ramp and freeing rep time isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Enabling a team on a growing platform is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a sales enablement motion? I'll tailor it to PrimePay either way.
